newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-WOMAN REFEREE STRIPS OFF TO SHOWER WITH PLAYERS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WOMAN REFEREE STRIPS OFF TO SHOWER WITH PLAYERS.

text.p: English women referee Janet Freweings has been charged with bringing the game into disrepute for stripping off to shower with players after matches.
Girlfriends and wives complained that Frewings, 41, was taking showers with their partners.
"We are aware that changing facilities are far from ideal," said a Football Association official. "However, we believe referees or their assistants should make their own arrangements."
